$comment: Delivered — the mold's own identity, stated explicitly so it is a product like any other rather than a default that happens to be baked in. brand_color is the mold's own --primary, and neutral_chroma 0 keeps the palette pure greyscale, so an app on this pack is visually identical to the unbranded mold.
tagline: The operations console for forward-deployed teams.
description: Delivered — the FDE operations console: an eve-powered agent that runs customer onboarding, deployments, and the data room for the forward-deployed team.
